Устная часть — отработка трудностей

Воркшит на закрепление ошибок по устной части: структура ответа в задании 4, связки и подписи (advantage / disadvantage, first / second picture), грамматика и коллокации, которые подводили в ответах, и прямые вопросы в задании 2. В конце два устных ответа: задание 2 и задание 4.

Exercise 1 → 5: автопроверка и отправка результата учителю. Exercise 6 → 7: запись голоса и отправка учителю.

Enter your name at the top, then press Start.

Exercise 1. The structure of the Task 4 answer

Task 4 has six blocks. Skip a block and you lose points for content (К1). Have all blocks but mix up the labels or finish badly and you lose points for organisation (К2). Match each block (1–6, in the order you speak) with what you say: click a block on the left, then its phrase on the right. The phrases are shuffled, so a phrase is never next to its own block.

Which label? Photo 1: a shared room. Photo 2: a single room.

Rule: if the phrase sounds pleasant, it is an advantage; if not, a disadvantage. «With other people» is photo 1, «alone» is photo 2.

your roommates can annoy you

it is usually more expensive to rent a room

you can save money

you have your own quiet space to study

you may feel lonely

it makes it easier to make new friends

Order: address and topic, description, advantages of both, disadvantages of both, opinion with a reason, one closing phrase. The opinion goes last, because that is where time usually runs out.

Labels: roommates annoy = disadvantage of the first picture; more expensive = disadvantage of the second; save money = advantage of the first; own quiet space = advantage of the second; feel lonely = disadvantage of the second; new friends = advantage of the first.

Exercise 2. Phrase frames and criteria

These slips repeated in different answers: the preposition after advantage, an extra what at the end, a missing the, will instead of would, and a closing phrase repeated three times.

1. Which phrase is wrong?

2. Choose the correct closing phrase.

3. In ___ first picture I can see a girl who is working as a courier.

4. As for me, I ___ choose the job from the second picture, because I like dogs.

5. You described only the first photo’s advantages and disadvantages and forgot the second photo. Where do you lose points?

6. You covered all points but labelled the second photo’s disadvantage as “disadvantage of the first picture”. Where do you lose points?

1. After advantage use of (or for), not to.
2. After all no what; one clear phrase counts as the ending, three repeats look like losing the thread.
3. the before first/second.
4. Opinion in this task is conditional: I would choose.
5. Two of four required aspects are missing, so К1. 6. Content is present but a label is mixed up, so К2.

Exercise 3. Grammar traps from your answers

Fill in the gap or choose the correct option. Every sentence is built from your own answers.

1. She is walking other ___ dogs. PEOPLE

2. While you ___ as a courier, you can listen to podcasts. WORK

3. If it rains, you ___ ride a bike. (три слова + to) NOT / BE ABLE

4. Will I receive a certificate after I ___ this course? FINISH

5. I would choose the job that ___ presented in the second picture. BE

6. You work with people ___ different ages.

7. Studying with friends is…

8. Choose the correct parallel structure.

9. Choose the natural phrase.

1. people’s (possession) · 2. are working (while + Continuous) · 3. won’t be able to (two modals in a row are impossible) · 4. finish (after + Present Simple about the future) · 5. is (passive) · 6. of (people of different ages) · 7. more fun (fun is a noun here) · 8. drop out or be expelled · 9. clean up after.

Exercise 5. Direct questions (exam Task 2)

In exam Task 2 you ask five direct questions in 1.5 minutes. A direct question uses question word order (Can I…? What times are…?), not “I would like to know…”. One meaning slip and the question does not count. Write the question for each prompt.
Спроси, сколько тебе будут платить (be paid).
Спроси, получишь ли ты сертификат после курса (receive, finish).
Спроси, какие времена записи доступны.
Спроси, можно ли записаться онлайн.
Спроси, сколько длится приём (last).
Спроси, какие документы нужно взять (bring).
Спроси, бесплатный ли приём.
How much will I be paid? · Will I receive a certificate after I finish the course? · What times are available for the appointment? · Can I register for the appointment online? · How long does the appointment last? · What documents do I need to bring? · Is the appointment free of charge?

How much will I pay? means «сколько я заплачу». After after use Present Simple (finish); a certificate is received, not worn.

Exercise 7. Speaking: exam Task 4 — School leavers’ decisions

Imagine that you are doing a school project “School leavers’ decisions”. You have found some photos to illustrate it but for technical reasons you cannot send them now. Leave a voice message to your friend explaining your choice of the photos and sharing some ideas about the project. In 2.5 minutes be ready to:
  • explain the choice of the illustrations for the project by briefly describing them and noting the differences;
  • mention the advantages (1–2) of the two options;
  • mention the disadvantages (1–2) of the two options;
  • express your opinion on the subject of the project – which of the options presented in the pictures you would choose and why.
You will speak for not more than 3 minutes (12–15 sentences). You have to talk continuously.
take a gap year  ·  save up money  ·  drop out  ·  get a degree  ·  have less in common  ·  stay in touch  ·  I would choose

You may use this construction for your exam-task answer:

Hi, Ben, do you remember that we are doing a project “School leavers’ decisions”? I have found two illustrations for the project and now I’ll give short descriptions and note the differences. I want to know your opinion about them, whether we’ll use them in our project or not.

So, in the first photo we see … In the second photo there is …

Also, I can mention in what ways the illustrations are different. First of all, … Secondly, … These differences are relevant to the idea of our project, I think.

Obviously, both options have pros and cons. As for the advantage of the first picture, … As for the advantage of the second picture, …

Undoubtedly, there are certain downsides. As for the disadvantage of the first picture, … As for the disadvantage of the second picture, …

Personally I would choose … The main reason why I think so is that …

Ok, that is all I wanted to tell you about these illustrations. Let me know what you think about them.
00:00

Record your spoken answer (up to 3 minutes), listen back, then send it to your teacher.
